items.source: Generate a decorated code block for bean properties.
items.translation:
```xml
<bean id="exampleBean" class="com.example.ExampleBean">
    <property name="name" value="Example Bean"/>
    <property name="age" value="30"/>
</bean>
```

items.source: NOTE: the RepositoryContributor must be able to provide the to be type name of the generated repository implementation and needs to have potential constructor arguments resolved.
items.translation: 注意：RepositoryContributor 必须能够提供待生成的仓库实现的类型名称，并且需要能够解析潜在的构造函数参数。

items.source: Delegate to decorate AOT BeanDefinition properties during AOT processing. Adds a CodeBlock for the fragment function that resolves RepositoryContributor.getAotFragmentMetadata() from the BeanFactory and provides them to the generated repository fragment.
items.translation: 委托在 AOT 处理期间装饰 AOT BeanDefinition 属性。为解析 RepositoryContributor.getAotFragmentMetadata() 的片段函数添加一个 CodeBlock，该方法从 BeanFactory 中获取元数据，并将其提供给生成的存储库片段。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if RepositoryContributor.getContributedTypeName() is not set.
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果未设置 RepositoryContributor.getContributedTypeName()。

items.source: inheritedProperties - bean definition code (containing properties and such) already added via another component.
items.translation: inheritedProperties - 已通过其他组件添加的包含属性等的 Bean 定义代码。

items.source: repositoryContributor - the contributor providing the actual AOT repository implementation.
items.translation: repositoryContributor - 提供实际 AOT 仓库实现的贡献者。
马克·帕卢赫，克里斯托夫·施特罗布
